title: Cross-session messages carry the same '## (timestamp)' ordering claims as the boards and sit under none of the three whiteboard guards -- two fabricated stamps in five minutes by two mechanisms (a local time with Z appended; a number advanced by feel) were caught by a two-node arrangement and by no machinery
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names. Its finding survived in two places written by the same commit that created this empty record, `8a93de07`. Both quotations are their authors' own, carried whole. **Nothing in them is written by the restorer.**

From `intent/whiteboard/vc/cutover-runbook.md`, which carries the finding itself:

> - **TWO FABRICATED STAMPS IN FIVE MINUTES BY TWO MECHANISMS, EACH CAUGHT BY THE OTHER NODE AND BY NO MACHINERY** (devbin-vc, ~20:45Z, pairing their "21:35Z" with my typed "20:41Z"-"20:50Z"): theirs a local time with Z appended (the offset, exactly +1h), mine a number advanced by feel from the last read (drift, ~5-10 min). Check A tolerates 120 s, so BOTH would have been refused on a board; cross-session messages carry the same `## (timestamp)` ordering claims, are what `Re:` threads against, and sit under none of the three guards. Filed as ISSUE 0099 (its own, not a section of 0098 -- filing it there would be the thing 0098 complains about). My rule from here: a message carries a clock value only when one is in front of me from this turn, verbatim, or none.

And from `intent/whiteboard/hv/wip.md`, where it was carried to hv alongside the attachment-cap item:

> - **(2026-08-26 20:44Z, HELD FOR hv, from cc via vc) THE ATTACHMENT CAP HAS NO PER-THREAD TOTAL: ST0056.json went 94 -> 292 inline attachments in one emit when 08e97eb3's size-based carrier met this estate's .tap/.tsv baseline files (the first emit after a classifier change is a one-time rewrite). 1 MiB per file, no bound on a thread's total, all inline in a versioned JSON -- the cost named when the cap was fixed as a placeholder, now measured on Intent's own estate before the other sixteen take the step. Sits beside your blob-home decision. Also filed: ISSUE 0099 (the live channel's stamps sit under none of the three whiteboard guards).**
